items.title: Sunday prep keeps failing by Wednesday
items.text: Every Sunday I cook five lunches and by Wednesday I am sick of the same rice and chicken. Does anyone rotate two recipes so the week of meal prep feels less boring?
items.author: user_1

items.title: Budget containers that survive the dishwasher
items.text: I bought cheap meal prep containers twice and both sets cracked in the dishwasher within a month, so now I only buy glass even though it is heavy to carry to work.
items.author: user_2
